sourceFindings.reason: A successful non-error records value governs selected record, filtered rows, empty state, creation branch and delete dialog; retained query.data is never used directly after failure.

Client/error read-scope changes clear delete confirmation; the error effect removes objective/new intents while retaining status filter. Delete mutation availability requires records plus a pending selection.
Cards, empty state and summary creation entry use current successful records. Failure renders retry without falsely declaring an empty list.

controls: 403 and 503 on an open real-route editor remove old values and URL intent; held retry cannot resurrect draft; successful retry supplies new record values.
Real Overview summary hides cached links and its creation entry after 403, restoring only a successful read.
Wrong-client receipt on actual client navigation is rejected and cannot retain former-client editor.
Ordinary successful same-key background refresh preserves typed editor draft.
Fresh replay covers stale remount, status filter preservation, summary errors, selected editor, new/delete state, late former-client response and DataProvider replacement.

architectureReview.decision: accepted exact responsibility and fingerprint within this repair scope
architectureReview.rationale: ObjectivesPage owns objective-list rendering, local status selection, URL-selected editor/create state and delete confirmation. The change derives every objective branch from one successful non-error list and clears local editor/delete intent after current read failure or client change. Query transport, schema/client receipt binding, mutations and form internals remain their existing owners. The added effect and render-time read-scope reset maintain the page interaction invariant and add no backend authority, persistence or unrelated domain. Keeping this 208-line composition together is proportionate; arbitrary extraction would scatter the same read invariant.
